title: Unauthorized Access to Stored Assignment Data
description: Sensitive data (student ID, course, submission time, assignment file) stored in DS1 could be accessed by unauthorized parties if access controls are insufficient.
assumptions: Data at rest is not encrypted or access controls are weak.

title: Direct Identification via Student ID
description: Student ID stored in DS1 allows direct identification of individuals, enabling potential profiling or targeted attacks.
assumptions: Student ID is a unique identifier without pseudonymization.

title: Linkability of Student Submissions
description: Combining student ID, course, and submission time in DS1 enables linking multiple submissions to the same student across contexts.
assumptions: Data is stored in a way that allows correlation across records.
uncertainty_note: Node L.2.1 assumes same-context linking; if cross-context, L.1.1 may apply.
